description: Weekly Number of Container Ships Awaiting to Dock at All U.S. Ports: July 2021 to September 2023 is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Maritime and Waterways", published or maintained by U.S. DOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. This metric represents the 'queue' or 'waiting room' for U.S. trade. The Weekly Number of Container Ships Awaiting to Dock is a primary indicator of supply chain health and port congestion. From July 2021 to September 2023, the U.S. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Maritime and Waterways". It has 5 columns, among them All Other Ports, Date, All U.S. Container Ports, Los Angeles-Long Beach, Savannah. The portal shows 2024-01-12 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. DOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
